tasks.title: Safe speed
tasks.solution: The quadratic v²/(2a) + v·t − (d − m) = 0 → v = a·(−t + √(t² + 2(d − m)/a)).

tasks.title: Dijkstra path around a square zone
tasks.solution: Offset along each axis d = M/√2. The path corners: (L/2 − a/2 − d, a/2 + d) and (L/2 + a/2 + d, a/2 + d). Length = 2·√((L/2 − a/2 − d)² + (a/2 + d)²) + (a + 2d). For L = 80, a = 20, M = 5: 29.72 + 27.07 + 29.72 = 86.5 m (SITL: 87.0 m).

variants.statement: A straight line of {L} m from start to goal passes through the center of a square exclusion zone with a side of 24 m; the zone center is at the middle of the line. tasks.title: Occupancy probability after k hits
tasks.solution: L = k·ln(p_hit/(1 − p_hit)), p = 1 − 1/(1 + e^L). For p_hit = 0.7 and k = 3: L = 2.542, p = 0.927, as in step 2.

variants.statement: A grid cell starts at p = 0.5 (L = 0). The sensor model: a beam hit has p_hit = 0.65. The beam hit the cell 4 times in a row. The module's clamp L = ±3.5 is not reached with these values (k·ln(p_hit/(1 − p_hit)) ≤ 3.39). What is the occupancy probability?
